mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (2000-2018).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals economic weakness and potential recession, causing investors to anticipate lower corporate earnings and driving S&P 500 returns negative over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0% (2000-2018).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based demand slowdown, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down > 0.5% MoM) does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases (2000-2018).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production growth signals manufacturing weakness and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, INDPRO growth decline does not lead to negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases (2000-2018).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals potential monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and pressuring equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0% (2000-2018).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in job growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.2% MoM) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) indicate a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (PAYEMS growth < 0.2% and UNRATE > 7.5%) does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases (2000-2018).

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized) signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% (2000-2018).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation, low rate regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), the central bank's limited ability to respond to inflation leads to negative real rates and reduced equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high inflation, low rate regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases (2000-2018).
